authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6333 divasa explicitly gives Gawri dōs, Savi dēs and Palula dẽs day. The survey des responses fit that day family. Reviewed comparison: Bshk dos “day” (f_tygdtl5sf65k2). Possible intra-IA transfer remains open; source forms and provenance are preserved.
